analyst: The script uses a delta-volume breakout entry. It opens a long or short when the POC delta imbalance supports the direction, the VWMA slope filter agrees, the required confirmation candles have formed, and price pulls back into the VWMA touch zone. The stop is a fixed dollar stop, default $250, placed below a long or above a short. It also exits on a take-profit limit, closes at session end if enabled, and can lock trading for the day when the daily loss or profit limits are reached.
